raw_text: A fabricated audio clip impersonating a sitting Chief Minister making inflammatory communal statements has been widely circulated on messaging platforms ahead of state assembly elections. The CM's office issued a categorical denial, calling it a politically motivated deepfake. A forensic analysis laboratory confirmed the audio was synthetically generated using AI voice cloning technology, with spectral inconsistencies absent in authentic recordings of the CM's voice.
clean_text: Fabricated audio impersonating CM making communal statements circulated before elections. CM's office denied it. Forensic lab confirmed AI voice cloning with spectral inconsistencies.
